details:
A world Entry/Exit effect...

---

1) World Entry

- When a player enters a world... on their spawn, the ground like, as if cracks, and the players character climbs or flies up out of it, then the ground is fixed and the players character stands there until they fully join

2) World Exit

- When a player leaves a world, their character would stand there for a second, maybe even look around, when suddenly the ground cracks bellow them, as crimson red hands appear out of it, wrapping around the character, then slowly go down, as if dragging the character back to the pits of the underworld from which it came from :D, then the hole fixes again

---

Basically the players avatar would *crawl* or *fly* out of the ground (depending on if the character has humanoid features maybe?) upon joining a world, and then when the Player leaves, their character gets *dragged down*, back to the underworld

would like it... if its possible... seems a bit funny to me... :D

portal could be an arch with the portal inside, the arch having slowly flailing crimson hands, having a crimson red aura around it maybe?... a portal to the Underworld... literally...
title: Warp Effect - Appear and Return to the depths
